info.title: GlobalShelfBD API
info.description:
E-commerce backend with JWT authentication and permission-based access control.

**How to test protected routes:**
1. Call `/api/auth/login` (the Admin email and password are in `.env`: `ADMIN_EMAIL`, `ADMIN_PASSWORD`)
2. Copy `data.accessToken` from the response
3. Click **Authorize** (top right) and paste the token

Access token expires in 15 minutes. Use `/api/auth/refresh-token` to get a new one.

**Response format:** every API returns `{ success, message, data }`. Errors return `{ success: false, message }`.

**Status codes:** 200 OK, 201 Created, 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized (not logged in / bad token), 403 Forbidden (no permission / inactive), 404 Not Found, 409 Conflict (duplicate / role in use), 429 Too Many Requests, 500 Internal Server Error.

put.summary: Edit my profile (name, phone, avatar, email)
put.description:
Any logged-in user, own account only.

- Changing **email** needs `currentPassword`
- The **password is never changed here**. To change it use forgot-password: an OTP is emailed, then set a new password with it
- Role and status in the body are ignored

Returns the same data as GET /api/auth/me.

post.summary: Step 1: Email a 6-digit password reset OTP
post.description:
Sends a 6-digit code to the email (from no-reply@globalshelfbd.com). The code expires in 10 minutes. A new code can be requested after 60 seconds (429 before that).

The same message is returned whether or not the email exists.

**Development only:** data.devOnly.otp contains the code so you can test in Swagger. In production the code is only in the email.

post.summary: Create a role
post.description:
**Permission:** `roles.create`

You can only give a new role permissions that you have yourself. Role names are unique (case-insensitive). Logs `ROLE_CREATED` and `PERMISSION_ASSIGNED`.

get.summary: List all roles with user and permission counts
get.description: **Permission:** `roles.view`

get.summary: Get a role with its permissions and user count
get.description: **Permission:** `roles.view`

put.description:
**Permission:** `roles.update`

All fields are optional. `permissions` **replaces** the role's permission list.

Rules:
- You cannot edit your own role
- You cannot edit a role that has permissions you do not have
- You can only grant permissions you have
- Protected roles (Admin, Customer) cannot be renamed
- Admin role permissions cannot be changed (always all)

Logs `ROLE_UPDATED`, `PERMISSION_ASSIGNED`, `PERMISSION_REMOVED`.

delete.description:
**Permission:** `roles.delete`

Admin and Customer cannot be deleted. A role that still has users cannot be deleted (409): move those users to another active role first. Logs `ROLE_DELETED`.

example.message: Role deleted successfully
Cannot delete role: 3 user(s) still have this role. Assign them to another active role first

patch.description:
**Permission:** `roles.status`

Users with an INACTIVE role lose all permissions until it is activated again, and the role cannot be assigned. Admin and Customer cannot be deactivated. Logs `ROLE_STATUS_CHANGED`.

post.summary: Create a user with a role (e.g. staff accounts)
post.description:
**Permission:** `users.create`

get.description: **Permission:** `users.view`

delete.description:
**Permission:** `users.delete`

You cannot delete yourself, a user with permissions you do not have, or the last active Admin. Logs `USER_DELETED`.

example.message: User deleted successfully

put.description:
**Permission:** `users.update`

You cannot edit yourself here (use PUT /api/auth/me) or a user who has permissions you do not have. Passwords are never set here. Logs `USER_UPDATED`.

patch.description:
**Permission:** `users.changeRole`

The backend checks:
- You are logged in and have `users.changeRole`
- You are not changing your own role
- The target user has no permissions you lack (e.g. a Manager cannot change an Admin)
- The new role exists and is ACTIVE
- The new role has no permissions you lack (no privilege escalation)
- The last active Admin cannot be demoted

Logs `USER_ROLE_CHANGED`.

**Permission:** `users.update`

Inactive users cannot log in, and their existing tokens stop working immediately. Logs `USER_STATUS_CHANGED`.

post.summary: Create a product
post.description:
**Permission:** `products.create`

Rules: category must exist and be ACTIVE (send `categoryId`, not a name) · stock is a whole number >= 0 · `customerSpecialPrice <= customerSellPrice` · `unit` and `quantity` go together · fabric products (`isFabric: true`) need sizes or unit+quantity · sizes are dropped for non-fabric products · thumbnail required.

get.description:
**Login optional.** Guests and customers see only ACTIVE products in ACTIVE categories, with `availability` (IN_STOCK / OUT_OF_STOCK) and never the stock number or cost.

Logged-in staff see more:
- `stock` with `inventory.view`
- `productCost` and INACTIVE products with `products.update`

**Permission:** `inventory.update`

Send `{ "stock": 50 }` to set a value, or `{ "adjustBy": -3 }` / `{ "adjustBy": 10 }` to change it. Stock can never go below 0.

**Permission:** `products.update`

Max 10 gallery images. To replace the whole gallery, send `gallery` in PUT instead.

No login. Only ACTIVE products in ACTIVE categories. Shows `availability` (IN_STOCK / OUT_OF_STOCK), never the stock number or cost.

**Permission:** `cart.manage`

Prices are refreshed from the current products. Items that can no longer be ordered have `isAvailable: false` and an `issue`.

post.summary: Add to cart
post.description:
**Permission:** `cart.manage`

Checks: product exists, ACTIVE, category ACTIVE, in stock, quantity valid (1-50), size valid (required if the product has sizes), unit valid. The same product + size is merged into one line. Returns the full cart.

post.summary: Checkout summary (validates everything, saves nothing)
post.description:
**Permission:** `orders.create`

Validates the cart (products, categories, prices, stock), shipping info and payment method, then returns the order summary with totals calculated by the backend. Call `POST /api/orders` with the same body to place the order.

post.summary: Place an order from my cart
post.description:
**Permission:** `orders.create`

Runs in one database transaction: validate → create order + items → reduce stock → clear cart. If anything fails (e.g. another customer bought the last items), everything is rolled back and the cart is kept.

Errors: `400` invalid input / empty cart / product unavailable, `409` `Insufficient product stock` or the cart changed during checkout.

409.description: Stock ran out during checkout, or the cart changed

example.message: Insufficient product stock

get.description:
**Permission:** `orders.view`

Another customer's order returns 404.

patch.description: **Login required**, own orders only (another customer's order looks not found). Allowed while the order is PENDING, CONFIRMED or PROCESSING (checked by the backend); SHIPPED / DELIVERED / CANCELLED return 400. Stock is restored, a coupon use is given back, ORDER_CANCELLED is logged and a cancellation email is sent. Order responses have `canCancel` to show or hide the button.

get.description:
**Permission:** `orders.viewAll`

All filters can be combined, e.g. `?status=PENDING&paymentStatus=PAID&fromDate=2026-01-01&toDate=2026-01-31&page=1&limit=20`. Dates are Bangladesh time.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Order number, customer name, phone, or email

get.summary: Order details (with customer account and allowed next statuses)
get.description: **Permission:** `orders.viewAll`

patch.description:
**Permission:** `orders.status`

Flow: PENDING → CONFIRMED → PROCESSING → SHIPPED → DELIVERED. CANCELLED is allowed from PENDING, CONFIRMED or PROCESSING (stock is restored). Any other change is rejected. Logs `ORDER_<STATUS>`.

patch.summary: Update payment status (separate from order status)
patch.description:
**Permission:** `orders.paymentStatus`

Allowed: PENDING → PAID or FAILED · FAILED → PENDING or PAID · PAID → REFUNDED. REFUNDED is final. Logs `PAYMENT_STATUS_CHANGED`.

**REFUNDED** gives back only the product price (subtotal - discount), saved as refundAmount. The delivery charge is not refunded.

**Permission:** `sales.view`

Counts **DELIVERED** orders (refunded ones excluded) on the day they were delivered, in Bangladesh time. `amount` = products + shipping - discount.

Periods include today: last 7 days = today + 6 days before. 1 month = 30 days, 6 months = 180 days, 1 year = 365 days.

`ordersByStatus` = how many orders are in each status right now.

Delivered orders. A refunded order counts its delivery charge only (its product price was given back); refundedOrders tells how many.
